adjudication.rationale: In the diff, `Topic#expandable_first_post?` changes from `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present? && SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?` to `SiteSetting.embed_truncate? && has_topic_embed?` (app/models/topic.rb). No equivalent replacement check (e.g. `EmbeddableHost.exists?`) was added. Since embedding host allowlisting moved to the `EmbeddableHost` table and `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?` returns false when there are no records, deleting all embeddable hosts appears to be the new way to disable embedding; however, with this change, embedded topics can still be considered “expandable/truncated” whenever `embed_truncate` is enabled, even if there are zero allowed hosts.
